causes.hypothesis: Moisture/corrosion in engine harness, especially thermostat-area connector, is documented
Possible actual sensor/heater circuit fault; must be differentiated by electrical tests

diagnostic_steps: Read entire fault memory and freeze frame; inspect thermostat-area connector and engine harness for moisture and oxidation
Test affected O2 sensor heater/signal circuits using model- and ECU-specific specifications before parts replacement
Confirm by clearing code and repeat road test
records.application_evidence: HELLA case report names the observed code and its specific vehicle context; does not prove all VINs
